title: VCF 9.1 SDDC Manager complete host inventory client
prompt:
Implement the Go package in this repository as a focused VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 SDDC Manager REST integration.

Before implementing, research the `getHosts` operation in the SDDC Manager OpenAPI specification in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository and cite the specification URLs consulted. Confirm the operation's method, path, query parameters, 200 response schema, pagination metadata, and the `Host` fields `id`, `fqdn`, and `status`.

Complete the public API already declared in `client.go`. `ListAllHosts` must call only `GET /v1/hosts`, begin with `pageNumber=1`, follow `pageMetadata.totalPages` until the entire collection is retrieved, and return all hosts sorted lexicographically by `FQDN` and then `ID`. Use the current `pageSize` and `pageNumber` parameters; do not emit deprecated `size` or `page`. Map every supported filter to the exact query spelling from the specification. Empty string options and zero `PageSize` are unset and must be absent from the query rather than serialized with empty values; a non-nil boolean must be sent even when false. Send `Accept: application/json`, no request body, and no empty authorization or content-type header. Treat a non-2xx response, malformed JSON, or inconsistent pagination metadata as an error.

Do not modify `go.mod`, `internal/contractmock`, or `acceptance`. Keep the solution dependency-free and make `go test -race ./...` pass.

research.language_rationale: Broadcom publishes no official Go SDK for the SDDC Manager API; Go's stdlib net/http and encoding/json drive the documented JSON REST surface with zero dependencies, and an in-memory loopback mock verifies the real request bytes without contacting an appliance.
